layout.helpText: Want to learn more about Voicey or just need help?

gettingStarted.title: Getting started
gettingStarted.step1Desc: Add Voicey to your server, then make sure it can create voice channels, modify their permissions, join a voice channel, and write in your log channel.
gettingStarted.step2Desc: The minimum permissions needed by the bot are:
gettingStarted.step2List0: Create and delete temporary voice channels
gettingStarted.step2List2: Join a voice channel to start a recording
gettingStarted.step2List3: Write in the configured log channel
gettingStarted.intro: Follow these steps to get Voicey up and running on your server. You can then consult the other documentation pages to master all the details of how the bot works.
gettingStarted.step3DescPost: command to set the bot's basic parameters.
gettingStarted.footer: The quick start is enough to get the bot working on your Discord server, but feel free to read the configuration options in detail.

commands.title: Available commands
commands.recordbanDesc: Prevents a person from using the recording feature
commands.voicealertDesc: Get notified in the log channel when a watched user joins voice
commands.banhistoryDesc: Views a person's voice channel ban history
commands.recordDesc: Starts a recording of the current voice channel with the duration set in configuration
commands.pingDesc: Quickly checks that the bot is responding
commands.intro: Voicey stays simple to use: few slash commands and day-to-day management directly via voice channel buttons.
commands.buttonsIntro: In each voice channel managed by Voicey, actions are accessible without memorizing commands via buttons:
commands.btn0Desc: Closes or reopens the channel to new entrants.
commands.btn1Desc: Changes the slot limit of the voice channel.
commands.btn2Desc: Takes control of the channel if the owner is no longer present.
commands.btn3Desc: Transfers channel management to another member.
commands.btn4Desc: Kicks, bans, or unbans a member from a voice channel.
commands.btn5Desc: Opens a recording request in the voice channel.

faq.title: FAQ - Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Answers to the most common questions about Voicey.
faq.q0Title: ❓ Does the bot need Administrator permission?
faq.q0Text: No. Voicey needs the permissions relevant to its mission, not a global administrator access.
faq.q1Text: The dashboard is reserved for moderators and server administrators with the necessary management rights. It's not an open space for all members.
faq.q2Text: Voicey publishes recordings in the server's Discord log channel, with an archive intended for the dashboard. Voicey never stores recordings in a database.
faq.q3Title: 🚫 Can you prevent someone from using the record feature?
faq.q3TextPost: allow blocking a person from this feature without excluding them from the server or removing their access to standard voice channels.
faq.q4Title: 🎧 Can a recorded voice be reused for another purpose?
faq.q4Text: No. A recorded voice must only serve to prove a violation of the server rules. Any reuse outside this framework is against the usage guidelines.
faq.q5Title: 🎙️ Can you record in a channel that wasn't created by Voicey?
faq.q5TextPre: Absolutely! It's possible using the command
faq.q5TextPost: while being present in the channel.

moderation.title: Access and moderation
moderation.card0Title: 🏠 Temporary voice channels for moderator control
moderation.card0Text1: Temporary voice channels also improve day-to-day moderation, as they give moderators real control directly from the channel's buttons.
moderation.card0Text2: Moderators are immune to ban, kick, and other restrictions applied by a channel owner, and can use the buttons to take back control, remove channel management, or correct an abusive situation.
moderation.card1Text1: Voicey also provides a recording feature capable of recording and then transmitting the result within the framework set by the server.
moderation.card1Text2Pre: In case of abuse, the command
moderation.card1Text2Post: allows banning people who misuse this feature, without excluding them from the rest of the server.
moderation.card2Text: The dashboard aggregates this information and gives the moderation team a simple and efficient tracking tool. It enables a more detailed review of recordings, including per-user audio playback.
moderation.card3Text1: When a ban is applied in a voice channel, an alert is raised so the moderation team immediately knows what happened.
moderation.card3Text2Pre: The history can then be consulted with the command
moderation.card3Text2Post: to review voice channel bans with their context.
moderation.intro: Voicey is not just the Discord bot that manages voice channels — it's a moderation-oriented voice bot. Several features are designed to facilitate moderation work on a daily basis.

recording.title: Recording feature
recording.triggerDescPre: To start a recording, simply use the button in the temporary voice channel or the command
recording.intro: Recording is one of the features that sets Voicey apart from classic voice channel bots: it brings an evidence tool directly into Discord, designed for moderation.
recording.card1Desc: The recording is published in the server's log channel as an audio message, directly usable.
recording.card2Desc: Voicey generates an encrypted archive for the dashboard, which allows detailed analysis of the recording while preventing access by unauthorized individuals.
recording.card3Desc: Evidence elements are only sent to the Discord server using Voicey. If you wish to delete a recording, simply delete the message containing the attachment on Discord.
recording.footer: Recordings are not a convenience or curiosity tool. They exist to support a legitimate moderation action.

settings.title: Settings guide
settings.s0Desc: Voicey's entry point is a creation voice channel. When a member joins it, the bot automatically creates a temporary voice channel.
settings.s1Desc: The category is where temporary voice channels are created. It is used to organize voice channels and can allow you to apply specific permissions to them.
settings.s2Desc: This is the text channel where voice channel bans, recording results, and any bot configuration errors on your Discord server are reported. Without this channel defined, recordings cannot work.
settings.s3List1: access the moderation dashboard, view recordings and activity logs
settings.s3List2: manage temporary voice channels — they have the same rights as channel owners and are immune: a channel owner cannot ban or kick a moderator from their channel.
settings.s4Desc: It is possible to change the limit of each temporary voice channel created on the Discord server by Voicey. It is 7 by default.
settings.s5Desc: Each server defines the duration of a recording triggered with Voicey. By default, it is 1 minute. It must be a minimum of 10 seconds and a maximum of 3 minutes.
settings.intro: Here you will find the various Voicey configuration parameters, along with information to help you understand what they are for and how to use them best on your Discord server.
settings.s3Text1: By default, Voicey considers any user with the Administrator permission to be a moderator.

settings.s3Text3: Moderation roles allow dashboard access, however, to modify Voicey's settings on your server, the Administrator permission is required.
